subject: Issue using rstan::rstan.package.skeleton to build a new package

messages.author: 06b7b6de953cb717
messages.subject: Issue using rstan::rstan.package.skeleton to build a new package
parts:
I'm trying to build a small package that uses Stan to fit a Bayesian model for functional data analysis. The attached files contain code that I've been using to fit these models so far. 

To create this small package, I run
> rstan::rstan.package.skeleton(name = "gfpca", code_files = "gfpca_Bayes.R", stan_files = "gfpca.stan")
make 'cleanup' and 'cleanup.win' executable, and run
> devtools::build("gfpca")

Doing so produces the following error:
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'gfpca', details:
  call: value[[3L]](cond)
  error: failed to load module stan_fit41cd4228d96f_BinaryFPCA_mod from package gfpca
Failed to initialize module pointer: Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...): no such symbol _rcpp_module_boot_stan_fit41cd4228d96f_BinaryFPCA_mod in package gfpca

I'm guessing (hoping?) that I've simply missed a key step that's already given in the documentation, and would appreciate being pointed in the right direction. 

Thanks very much for your time!

Jeff

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Issue using rstan::rstan.package.skeleton to build a new package
parts:
On Monday, April 4, 2016 at 2:59:33 PM UTC-4, Jeff Goldsmith wrote:
It does; if it helps, a .zip file of the current package (which fails to build) is attached. Again, thanks for your help!

I got it to build / install and am attaching it back. For future reference, it is easier to see what is going wrong by executing

R CMD INSTALL --preclean mypackage/

The main problems were
  1.  Lack of a license.stan file in inst/chunks which tools/make_cpp.R is hard-coded to try to #include . I have added an empty license.stan but you should fill that in inside /* */
  2. Declaring the refund package under Imports in DESCRIPTION (and also mistakenly adding an apostrophe to @imports refund in the .R file
  3. Lack of #' @useDynLib mypackage, .registration = TRUE in a .R file (so Roxygen was regenerating the NAMESPACE without the useDynLib(mypackage, .registration = TRUE) line
Thanks for using rstan.package.skeleton, as it helps me figure out where the documentation / automation needs to be improved. Some tips:
  • Put ... as an argument to gfpcaBayes and pass that to sampling, rather than hard-coding the arguments
  • Using a multivariate non-centered parameterization (Matt trick) in the .stan file. This would require inverting the Cholesky factor of the precision matrices and multiplying by independent standard normals

Ben

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Issue using rstan::rstan.package.skeleton to build a new package
parts:
On Wednesday, April 6, 2016 at 10:06:27 AM UTC-4, Jeff Goldsmith wrote:
The error arises prior to updating the .Rd files or NAMESPACE. The issue seems to be coming from zzz.R, although I can't figure out why. Did you have similar issues with rstanarm?

Yes. The documentation builds correctly with roxygen2  during the R CMD build process or R CMD INSTALL --preclean but it does not work with devtools. If you want to make the documentation just to look at, then you can call roxygen2::roxygenize(clean = TRUE) in R(Studio) when the working directory is the root of your package.

Ben
